title: You kept asking about my AI game dev workflow, so I made a video showing all of it
author: Diligent-Hat-6509
selftext:
A lot of you asked how I make my games with AI, so I recorded the whole process for my latest one: a Fall Guys style party game built in one day.

The short version:

• ChatGPT writes the prompts

• Claude builds the characters, animations and maps in Blender (Blender MCP)

• Codex builds the actual game in Unreal Engine (ChiR24's Unreal MCP)

Tip: you don't need to set up the MCPs yourself. Just ask Codex or Claude to install them for you.

Every prompt follows the same recipe: goal, reference, rules, and how to check the result. And yes, it broke a lot. The video shows every fix, including 4 rounds just to get the arms right.

Hope it helps! Happy to answer questions in the comments.
